transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, that helps. Next, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you! So, I'm very sensitive to bright light now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside. But if it’s severe, or there is pain, redness, or the eye is very sore, it may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. Lastly, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and then settle over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything I was wondering about. Thank you so much for all the help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts to the new lens" in the sixth turn. `mild_case_advice` was also conveyed in the same turn with "If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by "But if it’s severe, or there is pain, redness, or the eye is very sore, it may need checking."
